title: aster multiflorus var. ciliatus
intro: Aster multiflorus var. ciliatus, commonly known as the hairy white aster or white wood's aster, is a flowering plant belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae) native to North America. The hairy white aster is known for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The plant is also valued for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds, coughs, and fever. The bioactive constituents of the hairy white aster include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
